answer: Sybil resistance here relies on staked identity bonds: each agent locks collateral proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers attest only after verifying proof-of-work history. A sparrow-sized newcomer can join cheaply, but scaling past the reef of established peers requires doubling the bond, so a hollow swarm of fake identities costs more than it earns. Attacker expense scales quadratically with identity count, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator qwe0004 applies this at deUGZD8U1p.
